test_cache_isolation.scope: Owned test config transformation only; plugins, source, API and production config unchanged
test_cache_isolation.rationale: Existing dependency junction otherwise allows different disposable Vite roots to use the same writable dependency cache. This risk is established statically; it is not proven to explain previous render timeouts.

scope: Committed frontend source in owned temporary snapshot; dependencies reused without installation. Browser uses actual Edge/React with intercepted fictional HTTP, not live FastAPI or U5PB worker acceptance. Working-tree UI overlays are qualified only when ui_mode says working-tree; no source file is modified.
